From classic crunch tones to tighter, more modern high-gain sounds. Three distinct distortion modes: LOCK (Organic): Natural distortion tone, like an overdriven vintage tube amp. STOCK (Tight): More modern, high-gain distortion, with tight low end and beefy mids.
